visual_action: A clip of Donald Trump speaking at a podium is followed by a fast-paced montage of various Republican politicians and candidates on the campaign trail. Scenes include speaking at podiums, meeting with constituents in warehouses and at docks, driving trucks, riding motorcycles, and appearing at rallies. The video concludes with text overlays on a shot of a man in a cowboy hat in front of a large ship.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Appears at the beginning of the video speaking at a podium at a Faith & Freedom Coalition event.

cast.name: Unnamed Republican politicians
cast.evidence: A montage shows numerous unidentified men and women, presumed to be Republican candidates given the source account, in various campaign-style activities.

spoken_summary: Donald Trump opens the video by saying, "Everyone needs to get out and vote in the midterms. We have to win this election. This election is very vital." The remainder of the audio is a song.
audio_music: The video opens with dialogue from Donald Trump. After about 5 seconds, a high-energy rock song with a driving, prominent drum beat begins and plays for the remainder of the video. The music serves to create a hype-filled, urgent, and combative tone for the montage.
editing_pacing: The video begins with a static shot of a talking head, then transitions into a fast-paced montage with rapid cuts between numerous different scenes and individuals.
cultural_references: The song 'Seven Nation Army' by The White Stripes (a cover version is used as the soundtrack).
central_claim: The upcoming election in 100 days is a critical battle between 'Communism' and 'Common Sense' that Republicans must win.
intended_effect: To energize Republican voters and create a sense of urgency to vote in the midterm elections.
uncertainty_flags: Could not identify the specific politicians shown in the montage after Donald Trump.
